homebrew.description: Formula/*.rb pin per-arch release binaries (kc-agent_<v>_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz) with one sha256 each. Renovate's homebrew manager only understands source-archive formulae: it rewrites the url to https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/archive/refs/tags/<tag>.tar.gz and carries over a single checksum, which leaves `bin.install "kc-agent"` with no binary to install and the other three architectures unresolvable. It produced exactly that in projectbluefin/server#209. Bumping these formulae means fetching four assets and four checksums, so it stays a manual change until a generator exists.
